hero.description: For 4+ years I've been building complex software products — from problem analysis and system design to implementation and delivery — with a focus on React, Next.js, clean architecture and bringing AI into real products.

about.label: About me
about.title: An engineer who understands the problem, not just the code
about.p1: Software engineer with 4+ years of experience in frontend development, system analysis, and product engineering, specializing in React and Next.js with TypeScript. I've designed and built complex business platforms, ERP systems, and scalable web applications — from requirements and domain modeling to implementation and delivery.
about.p2: I'm currently focused on combining modern frontend architecture with AI capabilities and agentic workflows, to build products that don't just work — they think.
